title: Make AI summaries useful
tip: Ask for a five-bullet summary, then check the original source before sharing.

title: Write better prompts
tip: Give AI your goal, audience, constraints, and an example of the result you want.

title: Plan your week with AI
tip: Turn a messy task list into a realistic weekly plan. Review priorities yourself.

title: Use AI to learn faster
tip: Ask for an explanation, a worked example, and three practice questions.
cta: Try this with something new today.

title: Keep private data private
tip: Remove passwords, financial details, and personal identifiers before sharing text with AI tools.

title: Improve email drafts
tip: Ask AI for a concise first draft, then add your own voice and verify every detail.

title: Break big goals into steps
tip: Ask AI to split a project into small milestones with clear next actions.
cta: Save this idea for your next project.
